newsitem.title: USA: Oklahoma City schools report due Tuesday--Auditor.
newsitem.headline: Oklahoma City schools report due Tuesday--Auditor.

text.p: An auditor's report on the Oklahoma City Public School District is expected to be delivered to the Oklahoma County District Attorney and the State Attorney General Monday or Tuesday at the latest, State Auditor Clifton Scott said Friday.
Scott had expected to deliver the report by the end of this week, but a scheduling problem arose, he said.

The auditor undertook the report at the request of the district attorney and attorney general, whose offices voiced concern about the way the district was handling some activity funds, its self-insured workers compensation fund and some purchases, he said.
"We'll make a report to those people, and they'll let us know when we can make it a public record," he said.
